title: thymus commutatus
intro: Thymus commutatus, commonly known as Spanish thyme or wild thyme, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin conditions. Thymus commutatus has therapeutic actions such as expectorant, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs, diarrhea, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Thymus commutatus include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
